header: Secretary of the Treasury and Secretary

result.reason: Provision groups two independent term definitions under shared header; each defines a distinct term rather than being an exhaustive alternative, computation, or jointly-required condition.
Two branches split on who term refers to (Secretary vs any other official), covering all cases with no overlap.
All three sub-provisions (supervision, business purpose, 60% asset test) must hold simultaneously for entity to qualify as domestic building and loan association.
Provision defines a 60% asset-composition test that only means something once you compute qualifying assets against total assets and compare to the threshold.
result.inputs: total assets of the entity at close of taxable year; value of assets falling into each enumerated category (cash, government obligations, member loans, real property loans, REMIC interests, etc.)
result.condition: sum of the enumerated qualifying asset categories, measured at the close of the taxable year, is at least 60 percent of total assets
result.output: whether the entity satisfies this 60-percent asset test (true/false) toward qualifying as a domestic building and loan association
